name: wavely
description: Wavely — full-stack social platform (NestJS + React + Postgres + Redis)

scripts.setup: node scripts/bootstrap.mjs && npm run install:all && npm run db:up && npm run db:generate && npm run db:deploy && npm run db:seed
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run type-check
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules backend/node_modules frontend/node_modules backend/dist frontend/dist
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix backend run lint:fix && npm --prefix frontend run lint -- --fix
